checks.name: A fresh launch with no flags opens profiles with one profile, Personal
A legacy library found at an ordinary launch is offered for adoption; Adopt moves notes, chats and settings into a profile, leaves the legacy files, and later launches open the profile
Not now opens an empty profile and leaves the legacy library untouched
A --legacy launch still opens the single legacy library, for the development tours

limits: One machine, one run. The legacy library is a small fixture without a runtime; adoption of a library with a managed runtime is covered by the runtime adoption tour. No provider is signed in.
